Privacy

Privacy

This presentation version has no visitor accounts, advertising or added audience analytics.

Your message stays in your browser

The form prepares text locally. No message is sent to the school or stored by the application. Copying or downloading creates a copy on your device under your control. The site does not use local storage to retain this information.

Hosting and media

The hosting provider processes technical information needed to serve the site under its own terms. Media loads from this site; video starts only when requested. Before any real data collection, school leadership must publish recipients, retention periods and procedures for exercising rights.

Version dated 21 October 2026.
